points.description: States the answer TRUE (the OS still has opportunities to schedule READY processes and share the CPU without the timer interrupt).
Justification names system calls as an event/opportunity at which the OS can schedule (switch to) some other process on the CPU.
States that other events besides system calls (e.g. other kernel entry events) can also be used as opportunities by the OS to perform scheduling operations.

rubric.notes: Full marks need TRUE plus a justification that names system calls as a scheduling opportunity and says other events can also serve this way. A TRUE with no correct justification earns 0 overall, as the question states. Vague claims such as 'the OS can still schedule somehow' earn nothing; FALSE earns 0.
